verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference is a fair question for a SaaS CRM platform, but the pack contains no evidence of one with runnable examples. The only API mention is a generic marketing line, 'Discover Salesforce APIs & put them to work,' and the OpenAPI probe found no spec at any candidate path. CLI and MCP evidence belongs to other stories and does not transfer here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
